name: runemaster-scrying-orb-possession-4188
contract: Original Spell.dbc 804674 summons creature 50038 using SummonProperties 65 and promises direct control
and sight through the orb. A normal level 22 Runemaster cast must summon the orb, establish the native
charm and cease controlling the player; cancelling its channel must restore self-control. This probes
server possession state, not camera rendering. Public hertigservices/ascension-data
conquest-of-azeroth-creaturecache.tsv captures entry 50038 as Scrying Orb with display 30547, type 1 and
health/mana modifiers 1.0 (2026-09-04 capture). On clean main the normal cast failed because
Creature::Create reported that template 50038 does not exist.

steps.label: The Runemaster possesses the Scrying Orb
The native mover is the orb
Possession uses the Orb as native viewpoint_entry
Possession uses the Orb as native seer_entry
The cancelled channel releases the charm
The cancelled channel removes its Orb
Cancellation restores the player native viewpoint_entry
Cancellation restores the player native seer_entry
